supported_scope: The App can inspect project files through native read access across configured folders. This establishes file inspection, not a particular indexing or search implementation.
unestablished_scope: Automatic context-selection completeness and size limits
required_setup: Add the relevant project folders and retain the read permissions needed to inspect them.
constraints: Broader filesystem access depends on permission rules; project membership is not proof that every relevant file enters model context.
